title: Clinical comparison of different flap advancement techniques to per iosteal releasing incision in guided bone regeneration: A randomized controlled trial
authors: Zazou N, Diab N, Bahaa S, El Arab AE, Aziz OA, El Nahass H. Clin Implant Dent Relat Res. 2021 Feb;23(1):107-116. doi: 10.1111/cid.12960.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “CALF reported highest advancement, least complications while PRI reported the highest complications” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
